notes.title: Mars Attracts is now LIVE!
notes.content:
[p]Over the last three years our small team of developers and artists has been hard at work making Mars Attracts – a twisted park sim where you play as the Aliens from Mars Attacks and put captive humans on display for your Martian guests.  [/p][p][/p][p]It feels a bit strange to say this, but our strange little game is out now![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="NJlk74_E-YE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]That’s right, in case you somehow missed the news, Mars Attracts hit Early Access today. [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/58175/Mars_Attracts_Supporters_Edition/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]With that we’ve reached the end of the initial development stage. It’s a big relief to say that, but in many ways, this is only the beginning of the Mars Attracts journey.[/p][p][/p][p]What comes next is the really fun part – working with our Early Access players to develop the game even further, with your inspired ideas, crucial feedback and whacky suggestions as our guide. [/p][p][/p][p]Over the next nine months or so we’ll be continuously adding new features to the game, and also allowing the feedback we receive to shape our development roadmap. With any luck, this will make Mars Attracts into a far better game than anything we could have done by ourselves. 
[/p][p]Here’s to the next stage of the Mars Attracts journey – and we look forward to having you alongside us![/p][p]
Love,[/p][p][/p][p]Bernard & the Outlier team[/p]

notes.title: Just ONE MORE DAY Before Mars Attracts Launches!
notes.content:
[p]Mars Attracts will be hitting Early Access in less than 24 hours, and we can’t wait! [/p][p][/p][h3]Why Early Access?
[/h3][p]One question we get asked a lot is why we are making use of Early Access on Steam for our game. And what will Early Access look like for Mars Attracts? [/p][p][/p][p]As we progress through Early Access we’ll be adding new content – we still have a number of maps and human enclosure types that we’re fine tuning and we’ll be rolling those out as we go. 
[/p][p]There will be more missions, buildings, characters, and a much deeper story that really dives into the twisted world that really only gets hinted at in the original Mars Attacks cards.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157509/21a3871316bc63fbfa657dc2ce1665f8c81deb37.png"][/img][/p][p]We’ll also be adding depth to just about all of the gameplay systems, allowing the player to unlock even more control of every aspect of their parks. [/p][p]
But in truth – when it comes to changes like these, even I don’t know what we’re doing yet! And that’s the main reason we’re doing Early Access. [/p][p][/p][p]For our first game [i]This Means Warp a[/i] lot of the ideas that improved the game actually came from player feedback. [/p][p][/p][p]So we like to keep our roadmap super flexible in order to better integrate this kind of feedback as we go. [/p][p][/p][p]Early Access lets more players have their say earlier in the development cycle. As a result we have much more time to actually use this feedback to shape the game’s fundamentals, instead of focussing on fixes and add-ons to an essentially finished product. [/p][p][/p][p]And if you’re interested in the game we’re making, we hope you’ll join us on this journey. [/p][p]
You can join us on [url="https://discord.gg/2vQQjprDcq"]Discord[/url], where you’ll have the chance to chat directly to the dev team, pitch your own wacky ideas, or simply just complain about the latest bugs we’ve missed. [/p][p]
We're super excited to hear what you think![/p][p][/p][p]Love,[/p][p][/p][p]Bernard & the Outlier team[/p]

notes.title: New Features in Mars Attracts for Early Access Launch
notes.content:
[p]Mars Attracts will be hitting Early Access on Monday! 🤯[/p][p]
If you’ve already seen the game’s demo you may be pretty familiar with the concept - imprisoning humans for the entertainment of your Martian guests - but there are a whole load of new and reworked features that we will be unveiling for the first time with Early Access release. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Free Range Humans [/b][/h3][p]
In Early Access we’ll have five distinct human enclosures - Ancient Egypt, Ancient Rome, Viking, Feudal Japan and the American Frontier. [/p][p][/p][p]Each of these has its own distinct visual style, unique decor items to collect, and a special hero character that can be unlocked.[/p][p][/p][p]In addition, the Supporter's Edition features an exclusive Space Age habitat, featuring a host of new buildings and a very special hero character![/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157509/f6e06770680a706de922ed2e9c57ad7630e30b47.png"][/img][/h3][h3][b]Moody Guests[/b][/h3][p]
To keep your guests happy you’ll also have access to a section of rides and amenities. This is a management game after all, and getting those systems working just right has been a big focus for us since our demo teased a few of these systems out. [/p][p][/p][p]You’ll need to keep your food and drinks stalls stocked, your rides in good repair and your trash cans empty. You’ll also have to manage pricing to ensure you are turning a profit, and cater your park to the specific needs of the guests at any given time. [/p][p][/p][p]For some this will mean happy humans and a chilled cultural experience. For others this will mean death defying rides and humans subjected to all manner of cruel tortures and experiments. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]More Maps and Missions [/b][/h3][p]
Our selection of maps now includes an arena in the heart of a Martian city, an underground mine and mountaintop research centre.  [/p][p][/p][p]Populating these maps will be a range of special Martian characters. These mad scientists and sinister bureaucrats will guide you through the game, but they’ll also offer you unique missions which can be completed to earn their favour. [/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157509/2b40aa29a33ba360d501f0f78d2b5cb4c64aa4b8.png"][/img][/h3][h3][b]Reworked Expeditions[/b][/h3][p]
For such a central system, the way you actually acquire humans for your Martian park has gone through several iterations across development. [/p][p][/p][p]In our early prototypes, all you had to do was click a button in a menu and acquired humans would be beamed into the park. This was too simple, so for the demo we added the option to mount expeditions to Earth in order to capture humans to put on display. [/p][p][/p][p]For our Early Access build we’ve expanded this substantially, adding far more options to the scale and type of expeditions you can perform. In addition, human decor is now also acquired through expeditions, so if you want to keep your guests happy you should probably pick up a few beds, toilets and televisions while you’ve visiting Earth.  [/p][p]
[/p][p]Mars Attracts will enter Early Access on September 15, and we can’t wait to see what people make of it![/p]

notes.title: Final Tweaks Before Mars Attracts Hits Early Access Next Week!
notes.content:
[p]There are now just a few days to go before Mars Attracts hits Early Access on September 15. 🤯
[/p][p]As you can probably imagine things are very busy here at Outlier HQ as we prepare the final touches to the game![/p][p] [/p][p]We’re mostly focussed on polishing up bugs and making sure that the version of the game that drops on day one is as good as it possibly can be. [/p][p]
One issue that keeps cropping up is staff members failing to complete the tasks they’ve been assigned. Our Janitors in particular have developed a nasty habit of simply ignoring serious issues in the park, picking up stray pieces of litter while buildings fall down all around them. Right now we’re in the process of giving these lazy sods a good stern talking to, in order to remind them that they actually have a job to do.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157509/4df436fc5d6b2fabc6cad3d91edf06e12f03bb53.png"][/img][/p][p]As with many systems in the game, we’ve gone through many iterations and no doubt Early Access will see even more substantial overhauls, as we will very much be taking our cues from player feedback for what to work on next. [/p][p][/p][p]But as of right now, we can’t wait for the chance to share it with you![/p][p][/p][p]Mars Attracts will enter Early Access on September 15. We look forward to hearing what you think of it. [/p][p]
Love,[/p][p][/p][p]Bernard & the Outlier team[/p]

notes.title: Mars Attracts is launching on SEPTEMBER 16TH!
notes.content: [p]The time is almost upon us! We're delighted to reveal Mars Attracts will be launching into Early Access on September 16th! 🥳[/p][p][/p][p]To announce the date we also dropped a brand new trailer:[/p][previewyoutube="pbwSI19FIlo;full"][/previewyoutube][p align="justify"][/p][p align="justify"]Community feedback has played a major role in shaping development of Mars Attracts, and we aim to keep this going throughout Early Access.[/p][p align="justify"][/p][p align="justify"]Early Access for Mars Attracts is expected to last about nine months, with development following a player-guided approach.[/p][p align="justify"][/p][p align="justify"]We welcome feedback on new features and tweaks to existing elements through our [url="https://thismeanswarp.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9c4ce9a3e0a06379e3b38ff5c&id=f775a0b197&e=4602a913d1"][u]very friendly Discord[/u][/url], with this input  playing a major role in shaping our development roadmap.[/p][p align="justify"][/p][p align="justify"]We can’t wait to hear what you think about the game![/p][p][/p][p]Love,[/p][p]Outlier[/p]

notes.title: Mars Attracts at Gamescom
notes.content: [p]We have just arrived back from an intense week in Cologne, and wanted to thank everyone who stopped by our Gamescom booth! The amount of enthusiasm for the game was really inspiring, and we had a great time chatting to people about Mars Attracts.[/p][p][/p][h3]Common questions from the show floor[/h3][p]Q: Is it actually an official Mars Attacks game? How did you get the license?[/p][p]A: Yes! [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rCa2IXMzzLM"]Here's a video detailing exactly how it happened[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Q: How much did Martin (the Martian) cost?[/p][p]A: $400. Interestingly he came from the US with his box covered in TSA stickers. I bet they had a good chuckle opening that crate to find a Martian peering out! Last year I was stopped at Irish customs and asked what was in the box. I replied "an Alien" and the customs officer said "oh ok then, through you go!". Ireland... 🤷🍀[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157509/f882601abde779dc503dcd857006ab0aec865749.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Q: Can we buy a t-shirt?[/p][p]A: Nope - the Mars Attracts t-shirts are incredibly popular, but unfortunately for the moment we're not able to sell merch. Let's see how Early Access goes and we might revisit this![/p][p][/p][p]Q: How long have you been working on the game?[/p][p]A: Just over 3 years! We made a [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BiNV_endTvw"]"3 years in 3 minutes" devlog[/url] recently about the progress to date [/p][p][/p][p]Q: When is the game coming out?[/p][p]A: Very soon! Stay tuned for an Early Access date reveal next week.[/p][p][/p][h3]Press coverage[/h3][p]The game was also featured in The Irish Times, with a fantastic write-up about our Gamescom presence and how the Irish gaming scene is developing.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157509/4300e0d87f154ffa2853892fd0eabffcbfa32102.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We're now getting back into the swing of things and will have lots to share very soon. In the meantime, thanks for supporting the game and we're excited to be fast approaching launch![/p][p][/p][p]With love,[/p][p][/p][p]Paul & the Outlier team[/p]

notes.title: New Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
[p]Just in time for Steam Next Fest, we're delighted to reveal the [b]BRAND NEW[/b] Mars Attracts demo![/p][p][/p][p]This version completely overhauls the game's core loop, introducing a host of new features including...[/p][h3]

Expeditions[/h3][p]Abduct humans and items from Earth to populate your park, and store them in your inventory for placement or dissection.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157509/5b94b1a88a5db878a01a4cdd9a0c095c3444f2a9.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157509/dacec8a00f85278db6e4142c97d8b3fa2d1a4bad.png"][/img][/p][h3]Workshop[/h3][p]Disassemble unwanted humans to create "immersive" rides and decorations from the... leftovers.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157509/706fd8347a142955b99e38e2ffe4c468bea9db44.png"][/img][/p][h3]New Staff Types & Personality Traits[/h3][p]Recruit and manage 2 new types of staff - the Attendant to run stalls and rides, and the Porter to transport goods around your park. Characters also now have unique traits that impact how they perform their role and where might be the best place to assign them.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157509/a2eaceae485e48f41b71d50fdc738b459a239427.png"][/img][/p][h3]Financial Management[/h3][p]Adjust item prices, view historical trends, and balance guest happiness with the overhauled Financial system.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157509/6af97fad728748bdd39ac7d87321f45f22a3f7cd.png"][/img][/p][h3]And much more...[/h3][list][*][p]Saving & Loading[/p][/*][*][p]Performance optimizations[/p][/*][*][p]Improved character models[/p][/*][*][p]Revamped Research system[/p][/*][*][p]New rides[/p][/*][*][p]Updated tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Quality of life improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This is a huge update to the game and we can't wait to hear what you think! As ever, if you have any suggestions for improvement, discover any bugs, or just want to chat, you can talk to us directly on [url="https://discord.gg/2vQQjprDcq"]the Outlier Discord server[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Love,[/p][p][/p][p]Outlier[/p]

notes.title: Mars Attracts Devlog 07 - Lessons From The Alpha Playtest
notes.content:
Hey Martians and Martianettes,

We wanted to say a huge thankyou to everyone who participated in the Alpha Playtest! We received loads of fantastic feedback, bug reports, and new ideas to integrate into the game. We're trying to make Mars Attracts something really special, and having so many people engage with the game and share suggestions at an early stage is a HUGE help. Thank you! 💗

We've just released a video summarizing the key data points and learnings - check it out:
[previewyoutube=gd0v7rmbX4I;full][/previewyoutube]

We'll be implementing some of the most common feature requests right away:
[list]
[*]Move objects after they're placed
[*]More visibility over urgent character needs
[*]Better tools to manage human escapes
[/list]

And will be focused on two big areas for the next phase of development:
[list]
[*]System complexity - adding new and deeper systems that intertwine to form interesting gameplay opportunities.
[*]Differentiation - leaning into the darkness of the IP, as well as the things that make the concept unique vs other park builders.
[/list]

Thanks again for all of your input - this really is the best stage of development as we overhaul the roadmap based on your suggestions. If you have any more ideas, or would like to chat to us directly about the game, [url=https://discord.gg/2vQQjprDcq]join us on Discord[/url]!

Love,

Outlier

notes.title: Bizarre management game Mars Attracts gets its first playtest very soon
notes.content:
While building your traditional affair of rollercoasters, carousels, and hot dog stands is mighty enjoyable, I feel like the best tycoon games and theme park sims take you somewhere no other game in the genre does. Jurassic World Evolution, for example, puts an exciting prehistoric spin on the formula. However, upcoming management game and theme park creator Mars Attracts might be one of the most unexpected and weirdest new games of 2025, and your first opportunity to try it is just around the corner.

notes.title: Mars Attacks is back in Mars Attracts, a theme park sim coming 2025
notes.content:
Ack-ack-ack! Sorry, something in my throat. What I meant to say is, Mars Attracts is a newly-announced theme park sim set in the universe of Mars Attacks. The Martians have been capturing humans to take up to their dusty world to plonk onto a custom-built amusement park, where people are themselves the amusements - for good and ill. Think Planet Coaster, Rollercoaster Tycoon, or Jurassic Park Evolution, but in space, with lashings of human-centric cruelty.
